children: Italy's Treasury said on Friday it would offer a new BTP bond dedicated to retail investors, as it tries to increase small investors' holdings of its domestic debt.
The dual-tranche issue, with a five-year maturity, will be offered from October 19 to October 23.
For the first time, two different BTP Valore bonds will be offered simultaneously and can be purchased either separately or together.
The first tranche will have a 5-year maturity and step-up coupons paid quarterly, the Treasury said.
The second tranche, dubbed BTP Valore Insieme, will also have a 5-year maturity but will pay a single coupon at maturity, the statement added.
The Treasury will publish guaranteed minimum coupon rates on  October 16.
